snippet.title: Dark Hours - Official Cruise Into Madness Update Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description:
Watch the latest Dark Hours trailer to see what's coming with the new update, which brings nightmare mode and a terrifying new foe. The Cruise Into Madness update for Dark Hours will be available in summer 2025 on Steam.
Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for up to 4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and wish for daylight.
